properties.snippet: Used to delineate boundaries for each public hunting area within Kentucky.
properties.description: Boundaries of Kentucky Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources Public Hunting Areas. These are both Wildlife Management Areas (WMA), Hunting Access Areas, Outdoor Recreation Area, and areas for which there is some kind of public hunting allowed (liek state forests and state parks). The current hunting and trapping guide should be referred to for specific regulations. Tracts of different ownership are merged into a single polygon for each of the public hunting areas. Not all WMAs are in public ownership. Some are privately owned and have short term agreements to allow public hunting access. There are two other feature classes, " Wildlife Management Areas" and "Non_WMA_Hunting_Area_tracts" that are broken down by tract. That Wildlife Management Area feature class includes the ownership for each tract of the WMA.

candidates.title: Kentucky Heritage Land Conservation Fund Areas

properties.snippet: The purpose of this layer is to show tracts that have been purchased with Kentucky Heritage Land Conservation Funds. These funds can contribute to the state's nature preserves, state parks, state forests, wildlife management areas, environmental education areas, wild rivers or wetlands. KHLCF tracts may not represent the full boundary of a specific natural area. For a complete boundary of an area including non-KHLCF funded tracts, please refer to map services provided by the area owner.
properties.description: Established in 1990, the Kentucky Heritage Land Conservation Fund (KHLCF) is the primary source of state funding for the purchase and management of natural areas. It is used to purchase land from willing sellers for nature preserves, state parks, state forests, wildlife management areas, environmental education areas, wild rivers and wetlands. The KHLCF Board protects each site in perpetuity with a conservation easement or deed restriction. Legislation established four priorities for land conservation: areas that are a habitat for rare and endangered species, areas important to migratory birds, areas that perform important natural functions that are subject to alteration or loss, or areas to be preserved in their natural state for public use, outdoor recreation and education.

properties.snippet: Recreational Trailheads within the Commonwealth of Kentucky.
properties.description:
This service provides access to an aggregated set of recreational trailheads in the Commonwealth of Kentucky. State agencies such as Kentucky State Parks (KYPARKS), Department of Fish & Wildlife (KDFWR), Kentucky Nature Preserves (KNP), and the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) will contribute to this dataset. 

The data structure is based on the Kentucky Trails Mapping Standard adopted by the Kentucky Geographic Information Advisory (GIAC) in 2023. 

Updates will align with agency data update schedules.
